title: a nested anonymous action cannot rebind what it captured from the enclosing one
purpose: Invalid anonymous action forms are rejected before the program runs.

failure.justification: The contract makes this an error without fixing the detection stage; static analysis may reject it, otherwise execution fails. Either way the program must not complete.

provenance.expected_basis: spec 9.12: the rule holds for nested anonymous actions; `own` belongs to the enclosing action, so it is a capture in `inner` (#321).
